name: soullink-desktop-overlay
description: SoulLink Overlay - local multiplayer Nuzlocke SoulLink tracking overlay

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/server && npm run typecheck -w apps/desktop
scripts.test: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run test -w packages/shared && npm run test -w apps/server && npm run test -w apps/desktop
scripts.package:desktop: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w apps/desktop && npm run package -w apps/desktop
